title: A new terminal's view follows its daemon screen: the typed command's output shows in the app's own text and frame, not only in the daemon's
why: v2.2.7-opt (ef0b040d): the app's view of a new terminal kept its first, cut line while the daemon had the shell's output (5 of 9 runs; 0 of 3 on v2.2.6-opt). Decides regression or not; the expect step saves debug.surfaces, the budgets and a 3 s sample at that failure.
